CustomField.description: Routing (Batch tier only): at or above this article count the Batch Apex scoring run is split into parallel shards (up to Max_Scoring_Shards__c concurrent batch jobs) instead of one serial batch. Below it, a single batch runs. Default 51 shards any run that reaches the Batch tier (runs of 50 or fewer use the queueable tier). The 5-job overhead is negligible, so shard aggressively for speed; raise this toward 100+ if your org runs many concurrent batch jobs and you want mid-size runs to hold a single batch slot. Blank/0 falls back to 51.
CustomField.label: Shard Threshold (articles)
